definitions.explanation: Physical work that does not require heavy lifting, specialized skills, or strenuous effort. Commonly used in job listings for warehouse sorting, packaging, labeling, and similar tasks.

examples.japanese: {倉庫|そうこ}での{軽作業|けいさぎょう}のアルバイトを{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found a part-time job doing light work at a warehouse.

examples.japanese: {軽作業|けいさぎょう}なら{体力|たいりょく}に{自信|じしん}がなくてもできる。
examples.english: If it's light work, you can do it even without much stamina.

examples.japanese: {求人|きゅうじん}サイトで「{軽作業|けいさぎょう}」と{検索|けんさく}したら、{梱包|こんぽう}やシール{貼|は}りの{仕事|しごと}がたくさん{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: When I searched for "light work" on a job site, many packing and labeling jobs came up.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most common terms in Japanese part-time job (アルバイト) listings. Typical tasks include sorting packages, applying labels, assembling simple products, and inspecting items. Often described as suitable for beginners ({未経験者歓迎|みけいけんしゃかんげい}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軽作業|けいさぎょう}スタッフ (light work staff)
- {軽作業|けいさぎょう}の{求人|きゅうじん} (light work job listing)
- {倉庫|そうこ}{内|ない}{軽作業|けいさぎょう} (warehouse light work)
